body:
**Correction to the sprint 1 report (rp_01m45j3wtyq8nbqrmpycpx3trw):** streamed assistant text *is* masked.

The report's risk line and its follow-up "Mask claim tokens in streamed assistant deltas" came from DM-51's discovery, but sprint 1 had already closed that gap. The session manager runs every assistant_delta stream through `createStreamMasker`, and sessionManager.test.ts covers a token split across deltas.

The one gap left is two tokens glued together with no separator (DM-52 discovery). The plan draft narrows sprint 3's DM-201 to that case. It will be saved and adopted at the sprint 2 checkpoint.
